text: We support local and international groups in analyzing and implementing energy investment structures that enable efficient development in Mexico—aligned with their specific objectives—through effective operation, proper coordination with international business partners, and full compliance with their tax obligations. We assist our clients in the revision of financial models to evaluate their long-term projects and in assessing and designing funding alternatives tailored to each project’s characteristics, ensuring the successful raising of capital from institutional, public, or private investors. We provide support for participation in government tenders and auctions, as well as in joint infrastructure-development processes, so that all relevant tax considerations are addressed from the outset.
